commit fbce115e32d56c9c8bd62ddbc7e74c41c4aa9758 Author: Kevin Lamping AuthorDate: Mon Jun 8 13:48:25 2026 -0400 Commit: Kevin Lamping CommitDate: Mon Jun 8 13:48:25 2026 -0400 Bug 1991900 - Account hub: Hide helper text if error message showing. r=aleca When creating a new remote address book via Account Hub, if you leave the username blank, the error text will show over the helper text. Talked with design and the preferred solution is to hide the helper text when the error text shows. Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D304250 diff --git a/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser.toml b/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser.toml index df568761919..4046e6f0215 100644 --- a/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser.toml +++ b/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser.toml @@ -44,6 +44,8 @@ support-files = ["files/**"] ["browser_accountHubFooter.js"] +["browser_accountHubFormHelperText.js"] + ["browser_accountHubHeader.js"] ["browser_accountHubInput.js"] diff --git a/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser_accountHubFormHelperText.js b/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser_accountHubFormHelperText.js new file mode 100644 index 00000000000..d782e5f2805 --- /dev/null +++ b/mail/components/accountcreation/test/browser/browser_accountHubFormHelperText.js @@ -0,0 +1,121 @@ +/* This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public + * License, v. 2.0. + + await BrowserTestUtils.browserLoaded(tab.browser); + tab.browser.focus(); + browser = tab.browser; + + registerCleanupFunction(() => { + tabmail.closeOtherTabs(tabmail.tabInfo[0]); + }); +}); + +add_task(async function test_userInvalidErrorMessagesSupersedeHelperText() { + const form = browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("helperTextForm"); + const input = + browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("userInvalidInput"); + const helper = + browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("userInvalidHelper"); + const error = + browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("userInvalidError"); + + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(helper), + "Helper text should be visible on load" + ); + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(error), + "Error text should be hidden on load" + ); + + await SimpleTest.promiseFocus(browser.contentWindow); + input.focus(); + EventUtils.sendString("a", browser.contentWindow); + EventUtils.synthesizeKey("KEY_Backspace", {}, browser.contentWindow); + EventUtils.synthesizeKey("KEY_Tab", {}, browser.contentWindow); + form.reportValidity(); + + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(helper), + "Helper text should be hidden with input error" + ); + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(error), + "Error text should be visible with input error" + ); + + input.focus(); + EventUtils.sendString("a", browser.contentWindow); + form.reportValidity(); + + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(helper), + "Helper text should be visible after clearing :user-invalid form input error: " + ); + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isHidden(error), + "Error text should be hidden after clearing :user-invalid form input error" + ); +}); + +add_task(async function test_manualInvalidErrorMessagesSupersedeHelperText() { + const input = browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("manualInput"); + const helper = browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("manualHelper"); + const error = browser.contentWindow.document.getElementById("manualError"); + + Assert.ok( + BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(helper), + "Helper text should be visible on load" + );
